response.description:
You can now take advantage of Microsoft Entra
ID token refresh support in Python, .NET, and JavaScript client
libraries to simplify authentication in your applications backed by Azure
Database for PostgreSQL. With this release, your applications can automatically
refresh access tokens, helping you avoid authentication interruptions
caused by token expiration. This update makes it easier for you
to build resilient, long‑running services and background workloads
without adding custom token‑management logic.   Learn more: Token refresh with
Python Token
refresh with .NET  Token refresh with
JavaScript
response.title: Update: Microsoft Entra ID token refresh support for Python, .NET, and JavaScript in Azure Database for PostgreSQL
